platform: Node/Electron Main only; no Android or browser parity claim

api.closedHTTPInput: Exactly {method:GET,requestPath,status,contentType,cacheControl,body:Uint8Array}; own enumerable data properties only, no extras/proxies/getters; fatal UTF-8, no BOM; copies fixed non-shared and non-resizable original byte view
api.originalInput: Original aeeb review plus exact raw transport and both complete original SDK public snapshots, selected account/network, memberHash and transportHash; no replacement with latest consumed policy
api.output: Exact declarations are authoritative. Frozen public DATA binds operation/account/network/digest/action/nonce/original H values/both hashes and reports node-observed status, H and Comet index; omits raw/effects/logs/to/amount from normal observation
errors: Original aeeb/SDK and Node transport error codes propagate
api.effectsOnFailure: Keep original review, snapshots, custody, journal, UNKNOWN and first cause. No retry, replacement signature, send or record clearing.

producer.HTTP200: Committed or rejected indexed DATA; native original route cannot return indexed rejection, which its actual producer converts to 202 unknown
producer.HTTP202: Early or enriched unknown DATA, H zero and no effects/index; no not-found or retry inference
producer.headers: application/json with optional charset=utf-8; exact no-store. Node transport refuses nonidentity content encoding and all redirect/fallback paths
producer.numericPolicy: Root cometIndex is canonical uint32 JSON number; executionHeight/fee/nonce are canonical uint64 decimal strings, amount is signed int64 decimal string; nested effect numeric tokens rejected
producer.schema: Closed original PQActionView, duplicate decoded JSON keys and prototype keys rejected, complete standard-base64 bytes hash checked, original request path and both hashes bound
producer.fixtureProvenance: Exact responseBody base64 bytes from original fd8 http[2,3,5,6]; actual ABCI executor and HTTP with mock Comet; N2/index1, not live RPC/BFT/Source/Auth. Normal aeeb observation refuses this N2 fixture.

composition: Reuse aeeb inspectPQReviewedTypedTransportOriginal before inspecting response or doing I/O. Preserve full original SDK dual-AND validation and normal N1/index0, original review H and signing H separately.

Reuse existing PQTransactionNodeTransportKernel and NORMAL_OPERATOR origin/SPKI/build/network pins unchanged. Read-only facade exposes only readOriginal; never POST, caller URLs, wire transmission, retry or fallback.

GET status, genesis, typed ABCI hash path, status under original total deadline. Required Main current guard covers starts and await boundaries; post-health/late-lock/timeout failure suppresses observation.
Reuse original stream abort/close/timeout/late-response cleanup and first cause. Legacy transfer/finality APIs and byte caps remain unchanged.
Body identity binds original action, owner, fee, nonce, Member and transport exact bytes and both hashes; indexed H cannot precede original signing H. Member index zero is not Comet index.
No claim of actual network activity from the pure observer. Only Main adapter sets networkQueryPerformed after its actual read callback succeeds.

initialPure.productionDefect: Native original route wrongly accepted HTTP200 rejected; retained RED, fixed exact route semantics, final PASS
initialPure.testConstructionError: N2 test manually omitted action payload fields and received PQ_SCHEMA_INVALID; corrected test to use original f160 action reader, without production relaxation

validation.actualColdChild: Serialized review, both snapshots, original bytes and HTTP bytes are read in a new child process using original SDK snapshot parser; no WeakMap live review grant
validation.syntheticControls: One ephemeral normal N1 SDK sign per suite, handles destroyed. N1 response and event/TLS option transport controls are synthetic. No real account, actual TLS handshake, actual node network or BFT acceptance inferred.
validation.checks: CI entry patch applies; Main six-file proposal applies against saved e421 baseline and each resulting module parses. Main runtime/journal tests belong to original Main integration.

mainIntegration.behavior: Use Main private original record plus both original SDK-parsed public snapshots; inject GET-only reader into existing sender/checkPQ branch under original exclusive/guard. Return bounded observations for commit/rejection/unknown while preserving all false permission/retry/clear/finality flags and original signed-unsubmitted custody.
mainIntegration.next: Original Main applies owned leaf delta and exact proposal to its successor, wires supplied CI entry, validates journal/lock/cold-restart/display behavior; original A owns package/install/release.

proofDependency.state: Original Protocol has uncommitted typed proof collector source candidate; runtime and fixed response evidence not supplied for this component
proofDependency.boundary: Status decoder intentionally rejects proof fields. Proof collection and actual original independent Host trust/context plus original CLI verified outcome are separate required work; HTTP200 or CLI exit0 cannot imply execution success or finality.

status: 已验证未部署: owned source and focused controls only. Main integration, original CI activation, compatible package, normal install, real node read, independent Host proof and user flow remain separate gates.
